title: Temperature and Humidity (SYNTHETIC TEST DATA)

list.name: shipment
list.label: Shipment
list.query: SELECT shipment_id FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS ORDER BY shipment_id
list.definition: SELECT shipment_id FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS ORDER BY shipment_id

options.content: **Default range = the complete synthetic dataset (2021-01-01 → today)** so every shipment's readings are visible immediately — including 2021–2025 shipments. To zoom into one shipment's observation window, narrow the **time picker** (top right). A panel showing *"Data outside time range"* means rows exist but sit outside the visible window — not missing data and not a query failure. 'No readings in the selected time range' under a chart means the query succeeded but the window has no rows.

panels.title: Configured range °C
panels.description: Per-shipment configured range from the shipment record.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(temperature_min_c AS varchar(10)) + ' – ' + CAST(temperature_max_c AS varchar(10)) AS rng FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS WHERE shipment_id='$shipment'

panels.title: Readings
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment'

panels.title: Out-of-range readings
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY t JOIN FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id WHERE t.shipment_id='$shipment' AND (t.temperature_c < s.temperature_min_c OR t.temperature_c > s.temperature_max_c)

panels.title: Humidity observations
panels.description: 0 means this shipment has no humidity data — not a query failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND humidity_pct IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Alerts on this shipment
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_ALERTS WHERE shipment_id='$shipment'

panels.title: Temperature °C (configured limits as thresholds 2.0 / 8.0)
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, temperature_c FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.noValue: No readings in the selected time range — widen the time picker (full range 2021–2026).

panels.title: Humidity %
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, humidity_pct FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND humidity_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.noValue: No readings in the selected time range — widen the time picker (full range 2021–2026).

panels.title: Readings per day (coverage gaps appear as missing bars)
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(CAST(recorded_at AS date) AS datetime2) AS time, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' GROUP BY CAST(CAST(recorded_at AS date) AS datetime2) ORDER BY time

panels.noValue: No readings in the selected time range — widen the time picker (full range 2021–2026).

panels.title: Out-of-range readings
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP 50 t.recorded_at, t.temperature_c, s.temperature_min_c, s.temperature_max_c, CASE WHEN t.temperature_c < s.temperature_min_c THEN 'below' ELSE 'above' END AS direction FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY t JOIN FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id WHERE t.shipment_id='$shipment' AND (t.temperature_c < s.temperature_min_c OR t.temperature_c > s.temperature_max_c) ORDER BY t.recorded_at
